If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is mixed (alternating ±0.33) and forecast is flat, adjust mid-period forecast upward by 0.5–1.0% to reflect volatility.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days and forecast is rising, cap early-period forecast at 1.5% above recent peak to prevent runaway inflation.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days and forecast is falling, add 0.5–1.0% to early-period forecast to offset bearish bias.  
If sentiment is neutral (±0.33) and forecast is volatile, apply smoothing to mid-period values by averaging ±0.2% of recent 3-day range.
